architecture: v2 (re-root after SEND_BACK: winter discharge-to-assess packages across five hospitals)
slot_note: re-root of task127 in the same objective (Opportunity Sizing), wave 1 of sathay3012
niche: an NHS integrated care board dividing its winter discharge fund's discharge-to-assess home-care packages across five acute hospitals by the occupied bed-days each package frees, when a pathway-1 patient's delayed nights fuse the wait for home care with a wait for community equipment delivered alongside it
answer: Give Royal Marchford Hospital 508 packages, Wendlebury Hospital 350, Holmford Infirmary 120, Cleeve Park Hospital 222 and Ashby Vale Hospital none; they free 7,160 occupied bed-days.
answer_source: task127/generator/figures.json (call, packages, bed_days, bed_days_total, nights_per_package), asserted in task127/generator/checks.py
stakeholder_role: the integrated care board's head of system flow, who splits the winter discharge fund's discharge-to-assess packages across the five hospitals

spine.entity: one submission of an inpatient spell of a patient aged 65 and over ending in a discharge from one of the two trusts' sites, with its pathway, care package, discharge ready date and discharge time

world.org_type: an NHS integrated care board with a winter discharge fund, five acute hospitals in two trusts, and the county council's home-care brokerage

driver: The decisive quantity is the part of each unit's recorded wait that the offered intervention removes, because the recorded wait fuses the step the intervention replaces with a concurrent step it leaves in place, so only the replaced step's excess over the concurrent one, built by joining separate operational logs, counts; ranking units by the recorded wait, or by the replaced step measured from the same start, credits the units whose concurrent step is slowest.
driver_concrete: A discharge-to-assess package removes only the nights a pathway-1 patient spends waiting for home care after the community equipment ordered for their discharge has arrived, so the bed-days it frees are the nights from the later of the discharge ready date and the delivery to discharge, built per patient by joining the equipment service's order lines to the warehouse's spells; the delayed nights on record, which the brokerage's start dates present as the wait for care, credit the hospitals whose equipment waits are longest.
stump: A competent solver keeps last winter's covered patients, values a package at their nights after the discharge ready date (every record presents them as the wait for home care, since care starts on the day the patient goes home) and fills Ashby Vale Hospital first with 361 packages, then Cleeve Park 285, Wendlebury 350 and Royal Marchford 204, Holmford none, freeing 10,425 occupied bed-days, where the golden gives Royal Marchford 508, Wendlebury 350, Holmford 120, Cleeve Park 222 and Ashby Vale none, freeing 7,160; the step that lands it there is counting nights the patient also spent waiting for community equipment from the South depot, a wait that ran alongside the care wait and that a package does not shorten.
analyst_test: An analyst who reads every field and rule correctly keeps the patients the fund covers, caps each hospital at them and values a package at the nights after the discharge ready date, which every record presents as the wait for home care (the brokerage started care for each on the day they went home, and patients whose care restarted barely waited), and so fills Ashby Vale and Cleeve Park first, whose equipment waits ran alongside most of that wait.
domain_test: Bed-days freed by a discharge scheme is patient-flow analysis (the counterfactual length of stay with one discharge dependency removed and the others left in place); with another field's nouns there is no medically optimised patient waiting at once for home care and for community equipment, no national delayed-discharge count fusing the two, and the task stops reading the same.

differentiation.task127: v1 capped rebate slots by a co-op crew's weekly meter-set capacity queueing to year end; here nothing queues: the decisive move is which recorded waiting days a package removes when two discharge dependencies run at once
differentiation.task128: task128 books requests against a budget stated for the whole period and spent per interval; here the cap is a count of packages and the decisive move is the part of each patient's recorded wait that a package removes
differentiation.task119: task119 credits a unit with failed waits it could have shortened because its own beds stood free or held empty for planned work; here no bed is held: the patient's wait for home care runs at the same time as the wait for community equipment, and only the nights after the equipment arrives are removable
differentiation.task38: task38 recovers a remediation rule from closed cases; here no rule is recovered: the removable nights are built per patient from the warehouse's spells and the equipment service's deliveries
differentiation.task254: task254 v1 apportions burned area across zones by each event's footprint; here the decomposition is in time, the overlap of two concurrent waits in one patient's stay
differentiation.task36: task36's Osterhout R1 finds a decline in the joint distribution of two flat factors through a computed feasibility margin; here nothing declines: each patient's removable days are the care wait's excess over a concurrent process, built per patient
differentiation.task83: task83 v1 enumerates a population only by re-scoring current records under an archived model; here no model is involved: the removable nights are cut from each stay by the dates of its discharge dependencies

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how many of the period's placeable units a fixed team can finish before the period closes, because each unit counts only once that team performs one last step for it, the team's spare weekly capacity is visible only as the ceiling it held through an earlier unrelated surge, and the decision's own volume, bunched by its filed calendar into weeks no closed period approached, queues the later units past the close; the closed record's lag and an annual capacity check both pass, so the placeable count overstates the in-period total wherever the team is small and the units are many.
